Name: Custos Household and Home
Author: PandakittyRaaa
Description:
My mod contains some of my OCs that I really wanted to bring into the game!

They are all romance-able and live in a house south of Marnie's.

The mod contains the Brothers Taq and Na'u Custos, as well as their roommate Ashara.

I am still very much looking for feedback and testers. So if anything comes to your attention, do not hesitate to reach out via discord @panda_kittyart

As of right now there are also some minor issues when loading the mod into a pre-existing save file.
A previous issue was that they could get stuck in a bush in front of their house, I couldn't replicate it so far, but possibly have a bush destroying mod on hand should it happen.

This is my first ever mod and I have learned a lot, but also want to keep learning.
Ultimately I hope that this is a good experience for you still :)

Many thanks to the lovely people of the Stardew Valley discord:
- Abagaianye
- Specialagentjonson

It is SVE compatible

Downloads.Description: This version is compatible with SVE and Vanilla
